query: What are the protocols for Severity 1 production incident escalation, CI/CD code review SLAs, and test coverage gates?
final_answer: This verified enterprise brief addresses the inquiry: 'What are the protocols for Severity 1 production incident escalation, CI/CD code review SLAs, and test coverage gates?'. According to Software Quality Assurance, Automated Test Gates, and Code Coverage (DOC-POL-006), Enterprise microservice repositories must achieve and maintain a minimum of 80% automated branch test coverage prior to promotion to production environments. According to Information Security, VPN Access, and Hardware Allowance Guidelines (DOC-POL-002), Employees operating remotely are provided authorized cloud infrastructure credentials and corporate VPN access. [Sources: DOC-POL-002, DOC-POL-003, DOC-POL-004, DOC-POL-006]
